address.description: Full street address of the location.

slug.description: Optional URL-safe slug; auto-generated from name if absent.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier; absent to use tenant default.

hr.location.v1.LocationPayload.description: LocationPayload is a physical work location for a tenant.

address.description: Full street address of the location.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this location was created.

is_active.description: Whether this location is currently active and assignable.

name.description: Human-readable name of the location (e.g. "Downtown Office").

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this location belongs to.

slug.description:
URL-safe slug, scoped per business. Powers public URLs like
menu.rtylr.com/<business-slug>/<location-slug>.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. "America/New_York"); absent if using tenant default.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this location was last updated.

hr.location.v1.UpdateLocationBody.description: UpdateLocationBody carries updatable location fields bound from the HTTP payload.

address.description: New address; absent to keep current.

is_active.description: New active status; absent to keep current.

name.description: New name; absent to keep current.

slug.description: New slug; absent to keep current.

timezone.description: New timezone; absent to keep current.

id.description: ID of the location to update.
